description: This is a server setup script for a Node.js web application. It initializes the server, sets up listening on specified host and port, and handles graceful shutdown on SIGTERM signal. It also exports the server instance.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Starts the server and begins listening on the specified port and host

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Registers a listener for the SIGTERM signal to handle graceful shutdown

methods.name: server.close
methods.description: Stops the server from accepting new connections and closes existing ones

methods.name: process.exit
methods.description: Exits the process with the specified status code
